description: React component for editing an outgoing OAuth connection in Mattermost, including form handling, confirmation modal, and API interactions.

methods.name: getConnectionIdFromSearch
methods.description: Extracts the connection ID from URL search parameters.

methods.name: handleInitialSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, compares audiences, and triggers connection update or confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleConfirmModal
methods.description: Shows the confirmation modal before updating the connection.

methods.name: createOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Dispatches API call to update the OAuth connection and handles success or error.

methods.name: renderExtra
methods.description: Renders the confirmation modal with messages and actions.
